title: Stale Service Account: svc-deploy-prod
description: Service account svc-deploy-prod has not authenticated in 90 days but still holds deploy permissions on the production Kubernetes cluster. No owning team could be identified in the last access review.

title: Overprivileged API Key: analytics-reader
description: API key 'analytics-reader' is scoped with full read/write access to the data warehouse, but usage logs show only SELECT queries over the last 6 months. Recommend scoping down to read-only.

title: Expiring Service Principal: sp-backup-agent (7 days)
description: Azure service principal sp-backup-agent's client secret expires in 7 days. It is used by the nightly backup job for the billing database — rotation must happen before expiry to avoid a failed backup.

title: Unused Machine Identity: bot-legacy-sync
description: Machine identity bot-legacy-sync has had zero API calls in 180 days. Originally provisioned for a data sync job that was migrated to a new pipeline last quarter. Candidate for deprovisioning.

title: Shared Service Account: svc-monitoring (used by 3 teams)
description: svc-monitoring's credentials are shared across the Platform, SRE, and Data teams with no per-team attribution possible in audit logs. Recommend splitting into per-team identities.

title: Stale API Key: key-ci-runner-2023
description: CI runner key from the 2023 pipeline migration was never revoked after cutover to the new runner fleet. Confirmed unused since the migration; already rotated out of all pipeline configs.

title: Overprivileged Service Account: svc-data-export (write access to prod)
description: svc-data-export is used exclusively by a read-only nightly export job, but its IAM role grants write access to the production database. Principle of least privilege violation.

title: Expiring OAuth Client Secret: oauth-partner-portal (3 days)
description: The OAuth client secret for the partner-portal integration expires in 3 days. This integration is actively used by two enterprise partners for SSO — an unplanned expiry would lock them out.

title: Stale Service Account: svc-etl-worker
description: svc-etl-worker has not run in 60 days after the ETL pipeline it served was decommissioned. Still holds read access to three production databases.

title: Overprivileged API Key: reporting-service
description: The reporting-service API key has org-admin scope but the service only needs read access to two reporting endpoints. Flagged in the latest quarterly access review.
